about: Android share target: text, links and files shared to the installed app arrive in a chooser (a new note, or added to a note). The service worker keeps the share in a cache; the page reads it once.
needs: app/public/sw.js: the POST ./share-in fetch handler that fills the 'share-in' cache and redirects to ./?share=1; bump VERSION, then node tools/sw-files.mjs app

docs: Works in the installed app on Android only. A share while the option is off says so and keeps nothing.
